*.text: Mississippi context. The Mississippi Public Service Commission regulates Entergy Mississippi, Mississippi Power and Cooperative Energy; docket numbers look like 2022-UA-153, and the portal needs a session, so cite the docket number and document name or the monthly docket list PDF. Air permits come from the Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality (MDEQ) Permit Board through enSearch Online. Read the harvested permit index in work/permits/us-ms/<plant id>.md and the dockets and queue entries on this brief first. Entergy Mississippi and Cooperative Energy are in MISO, Mississippi Power is in the Southern Company balancing area, and TVA serves the north of the state. TVA projects need no state certificate; TVA environmental reviews and records of decision are the approval documents.

L100001047324.text: Re-research in full: the April 2026 review recorded no changes. Colossus 2 is xAI's data center power plant. Unit 1 is the operating temporary turbines (495 MW, listed in Status Detail), unit 2 is 1,240.5 MW of Solar Turbines Titan 350 sets, pre-construction, 2027. Read the MDEQ air permit for the MZX Tech LLC facility (agency interest 12592) and any later permit or modification. Check the number and size of the Titan 350 turbines against unit 2's capacity, and whether they form one set behind one grid connection or separate units. Check the owner name: MDEQ says MZX Tech LLC, GEM says MZT Tech LLC. The possible-updates sheet has a May 2026 row: change of ownership and additional gas turbines (an ESG Dive story on the NAACP lawsuit over the turbines). Answer it, including the Solaris Energy Infrastructure joint venture named in Notes. Report whether unit 2 construction has begun, with dated sources.

L100001025781.text: Re-research in full: the April 2026 review recorded no changes. Delta Blues is Entergy Mississippi's combined cycle at Greenville. GEM says construction and 754 MW, start 2028. EIA-860M September 2026 says regulatory approvals pending, not under construction. Settle the status with dated sources (the Public Service Commission certificate order, the MDEQ air permit, Entergy releases or quarterly reports), and record a Latest Activity entry.

L100001023568.text: Re-research in full: the April 2026 review recorded no changes. New Caledonia is TVA's six-unit GE 7E.03 peaking plant in Lowndes County, construction since the October 22, 2025 groundbreaking, start 2028. Check capacity per unit (EIA says 84 MW each), the start year, the MDEQ air permit, and record a Latest Activity entry with a dated source.

L100001064651.text: Re-research in full: the April 2026 review recorded no changes. Traceview is Entergy Mississippi's combined cycle in Madison County; its MDEQ permit is under the name Madison County Advanced Power Station (agency interest 89056). GEM says announced, 760 MW, 2029, and has no turbine make and model. EIA-860M September 2026 lists plant 70187 as under construction with CT1 477.7 MW and ST1 341.7 MW, planned 2028. Find the status, capacity, start year and turbine model from the air permit, the Public Service Commission docket and Entergy sources. The location is approximate; the location task on this brief applies.

L100001080981.text: Re-research in full: the April 2026 review recorded no changes. Vicksburg is Entergy Mississippi's combined cycle at the Baxter Wilson site, construction, 750 MW, 2028. EIA-860M September 2026 lists GT1 477.7 MW and ST1 341.7 MW, about 819 MW. Check the capacity against the air permit and Entergy filings, the start year, and record a Latest Activity entry.

L100000401834.text: Unit 3 (59 MW steam unit) has a planned retirement of 2025, which has passed. Find out from Cooperative Energy, EIA-860M or MDEQ whether it retired, and when. If it retired, give the year with sources; if not, find the new planned date.

L100000402325.text: The possible-updates sheet marks TVA's carbon capture study at Ackerman (this plant, TVA Ackerman Combined Cycle in the MDEQ permit) as 'check next cycle'. Find the newest TVA or Department of Energy document on the study and say whether anything changed: a funded project, a decision or a cancellation. Report the carbon capture box only on a source that names this plant.

L100000402097.text: The coal side of Plant Daniel has unit 2 with a planned retirement of 2029 in the unfiltered export. Check Mississippi Power's 2024 integrated resource plan and later filings for a gas conversion or a gas replacement at Daniel. The Sierra Club list mentions a planned 548 MW unit 2 here; identify what it is from a public source and stage it only on that source.

L100000401627.text: GEM's owner is GE Energy Financial Services Inc, but MDEQ names the facility TVA Caledonia Combined Cycle Plant. Find who owns the plant now and since when, with a dated source, and run entity_lookup.py before staging any owner.

L100000401922.text: Unit 2 has a retired year of 2018, before the 2020 floor for retired units. Amalia Llano added it in July 2025, likely as the link for the Vicksburg replacement. Do not stage a change to unit 2; write one question for Amalia that states what the sources say about its retirement. Check unit 1's 2023 retirement date and source.

L100000402094.text: Optional check: Chevron Pascagoula's 101 MW gas turbine sits at the Chevron refinery and its captive fields are blank. If a source says the plant serves the refinery, fill the captive fields with that source.
